name: job-scraper
description: JobScraper - AI-assisted job sourcing for Job Seekers

scripts.dev:apps: pnpm --filter @job-scraper/shared build && concurrently --names shared,backend,frontend --prefix-colors magenta,blue,green --kill-others-on-fail "pnpm --filter @job-scraper/shared dev" "pnpm --filter @job-scraper/backend dev" "pnpm --filter @job-scraper/frontend dev"
scripts.check: turbo run lint typecheck test && prettier --check .
